text:
mira: FYI onboarding sample app is failing for tool/function calling with structured outputs on the async path. Repro in prod-sample is throwing a serialization error.

mira: Stacktrace pasted below (using redwood-inference==0.14.2):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/main.py", line 42, in <module>
    result = await client.call_tool(
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/client/async_client.py", line 123, in call_tool
    payload = _serialize_structured_output(schema, output)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/_struct.py", line 88, in _serialize_structured_output
    raise TypeError("Failed to coerce dataclass to json")
TypeError: Failed to coerce dataclass to json
```

mira: Minimal repro - this is literally the sample app flow:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient, Schema

client = AsyncClient(api_key=ENV_TOKEN)

class Person(Schema):
    name: str
    age: int

async def run():
    out = await client.call_tool(
        name="format_person",
        input={"raw": "Mira, 29"},
        response_schema=Person,
    )
    return out
```

sam: Can you paste the exact object you returned from the tool? is it a dataclass instance or a dict?

mira: It's a dataclass (we map DB row -> dataclass then return). When I switch to returning a dict it works.

anya: I think there's a known async edge where dataclass coercion runs inside a threadpool and the loop context is lost, causing the serializer to raise. Also saw logs where a 401 happens during token refresh and then the retry path gets short-circuited. Reposting snippet from app logs:
```
[2026-03-20T16:11:02Z] request -> /v1/toolcall 401 token_expired
[2026-03-20T16:11:02Z] auth: refresh token -> 200
[2026-03-20T16:11:03Z] retry suppressed: missing-idempotency-header
[2026-03-20T16:11:03Z] call_tool -> serialization error
```

ben: I hit something like this last week. Workaround was to explicitly marshal dataclass to dict before returning from the tool, e.g. `asdict(person)` in sample app. Not ideal for DX though.

mira: asdict works but it breaks type hints for new users in our sample app (mypy complains that return type is not `Person`). editors flag it and it's confusing for onboarding.

kyle-devex: Thanks for the report — this is definitely a priority. Quick notes:
- Root cause: async path accidentally runs the struct-output coercer inside ThreadPoolExecutor without propagating our runtime "serializer hooks" which handle dataclasses.
- Secondary: the async retry token-refresh flow was returning early on 401s for toolcall which triggered the serialization path when the response object was stale.

kyle-devex: Plan: patch the async coercer to run in the main loop (no threadpool) and add an explicit retry for token refresh on toolcall. I'll open a PR and include a small e2e sample.

mira: Awesome. Any ETA? this blocks a bunch of onboarding feedback fyi. :grimacing:

kyle-devex: I can scope a fix + tests and cut a 0.14.3 hotfix today (ETA ~ 6 hours). Will add a changelog entry and a note to upgrade sample app. PR will be linked here. :thumbsup:

sam: Also, can we add a unit test in devex-ci that runs the sample app against the async toolcall path? would catch this earlier.

kyle-devex: Good idea. I'll add an e2e check in the sample-app job (runs under matrix with sync/async and dataclass/dict outputs).

anya: Also recommend making the SDK docs sample return a `dict` in the example but comment that dataclasses are supported and point to the migration note until we ship the hotfix. Minimizes confusion for new users.

mira: Will update the sample-app README to show the `asdict()` temp workaround and link to this thread. Happy to validate the hotfix once it's out.

ci-bot: build/sample-app (python-matrix) started for commit abc123 -> job #4521

kyle-devex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/3892 — includes fix + tests. Marking as hotfix.

mira: Verified locally against the PR branch — async toolcall + dataclass now serializes correctly. No mypy complaints when we keep the dataclass return. Thanks! :raised_hands:

ben: Great, will roll the sample-app dep when release cuts.

kyle-devex: Cutting 0.14.3 now. Release notes: "Fix async structured-output coercion and token-refresh retry for tool/function calling (hotfix)."

mira: Thanks team. Follow-up: can we add a small doc blurb about expected return shapes from tool functions (dataclass vs dict) so new devs don't get caught?

kyle-devex: Agreed — adding to devdocs and sample-app README.

mira: closing loop here. If anyone else hits weird async-toolcall behavior ping me or @kyle-devex.
